The outcome of a road test should be based on your driving skills, ability to follow traffic laws, and demonstration of safe driving practices, not the type of vehicle you used to practice. The instructor's evaluation should be fair and unbiased, focusing on your performance as a driver, regardless of the vehicle you used. Practicing in an expensive sports car may have provided a comfortable and enjoyable experience, but it doesn't necessarily guarantee a passing grade if your driving skills are not up to par.
